title: Simultaneous ring coordinates for tensor stalk comparisons
statement: For a cartesian square X\xleftarrow{g\prime}X\prime with vertical maps f:X\to S and f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime and base map g:S\prime\to S [def-pc-base-change], quasi-coherent derived objects E,K on X and K\prime on X\prime [def-pc-derived-category], a morphism phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime, and the canonical tensor comparison on derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] with its specified K-flat and shared-counit equations, take coordinates c for phi and d for its induced tensor map and a point z [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Set R=O_{S,f(g\prime z)}, A=O_{X,g\prime z}, B=O_{S\prime,f\prime z}, C=O_{X\prime,z} with their actual stalk maps. Then C is flat over A\otimes_R B. There exist K-flat A-complexes U,Q, a C-complex N, a map t:F(Q)\to N where F is termwise A-to-C extension, and cohomology models m,m_U [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for Q,U\otimes Q. For every i there are source and target isomorphisms giving commuting squares between stalkComparison(c,z,i) and m.localizedComparison(i);H^i(t), and between stalkComparison(d,z,i) and m_U.localizedComparison(i);H^i(mu_F(U,Q)^{-1};(F(U) tensor t)). No invertibility of the horizontal arrows is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the map from Spec(A tensor_R B) to X prime by the local-spectrum pullback map followed by the inverse of the square isomorphism with the chosen pullback. It is a preimmersion. The four actual stalk-map equations show that Spec C to Spec(A tensor_R B) followed by this map is X prime.fromSpecStalk(z). This composite is flat; cancellation along the monomorphism and the affine flatness criterion prove C flat over the tensor ring. This proof is the private stalkTensor_flat helper and works for arbitrary cartesian squares directly.

Choose existing coordinates e for the identity pullback map on E. Set U=stalk(e.P), Q=stalk(c.P), N=stalk(c.N) and t=tensorStalkIso(c.P);stalk(c.t). The stalk K-flat criterion supplies both acyclicity conclusions. Use the canonical model for U tensor Q and the existing cohomologyModel(c.P) for Q.

Apply the fixed-map tensor-square theorem to e.P,e.e,e.isKFlat for a_U,b_U. For the original square use identity isomorphisms a,b: its equality is the definition of stalkComparison, homologyMap_comp, and the identity laws. Combine the flatness, the two K-flatness witnesses, and both comparison equations.

theorem exists_tensorStalkComparison_squares
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (E K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K.obj ⟶ K'.obj)
    (τ : ∀ A B : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback g').obj (A ⊗ B) ⟶
        (derivedPullback g').obj A ⊗ (derivedPullback g').obj B)
    (hτ : IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison g' τ)
    (c : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' K.obj K'.obj φ)
    (d : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' (E.obj ⊗ K.obj)
      (((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj) ⊗ K'.obj)
      (τ E.obj K.obj ≫ ((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj ◁ φ))) (z : X') :
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z))
    let R := SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z
    let A := SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' z
    let B := SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z
    let C := SingleComplexBaseChange.C z
    let F := (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C).comp
        (algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C)
    let S := (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace z).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    Module.Flat (TensorProduct R A B) C ∧
    ∃ (U Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} C) ℤ)
      (_ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
      (_ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
      (t : F.obj Q ⟶ N)
      (m : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
      (mU : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C),
      ∀ i : ℤ,
      ∃ (a : G.obj (m.cohomology i) ≅
          G.obj ((SingleComplexBaseChange.cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z c.P).cohomology i))
        (b : N.homology i ≅ (S.obj c.N).homology i)
        (aU : G.obj (mU.cohomology i) ≅
          G.obj ((SingleComplexBaseChange.cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z d.P).cohomology i))
        (bU : (F.obj U ⊗ N).homology i ≅ (S.obj d.N).homology i),
        a.hom ≫ SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison f f' g g' sq c z i =
          m.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t i ≫ b.hom ∧
        aU.hom ≫ SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison f f' g g' sq d z i =
          mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i ≫ bU.hom
